div.aria-label: Bare-metal profile: users reach two control-plane hosts through an HAProxy pair; engines use a three-node Patroni PostgreSQL cluster with pgBackRest backups and a shared blob share; agents on Windows/Linux machines run task hosts that load services under test.

header.p: Labs, on-prem and Autopilot-style fleets. wf-api and wf-engine run as OS services (systemd / Windows Service) on two hosts; PostgreSQL HA via Patroni. Supported by the same code, but not the first build target (that is a single workstation).
